message: Exact Ether balance equality with 'totalDeposits' can make deposits or withdrawals revert after Ether is forcibly sent to the contract.

suggestedFix.description: Do not require the raw contract balance to exactly equal recorded deposits or liabilities. Check that the balance covers liabilities, and handle any surplus explicitly.
suggestedFix.codeSnippet:
require(address(this).balance >= totalLiabilities, "Insolvent");
uint256 surplus = address(this).balance - totalLiabilities;

confidenceEvidence: An exact address(this).balance == accounting-variable expression appears directly in require/assert.
The compared identifier 'totalDeposits' is named like tracked native-asset accounting.
metadata.severityRationale: Forced Ether is not itself a vulnerability; the exact equality guard can block value-bearing operations when raw balance and recorded liabilities diverge.
metadata.limitation: Source-pattern analysis does not prove that the guard is reachable or that a failing operation causes asset loss.
